title: Teeminanɗe jeenay Noddaango
intro: Natal dariiwal tan e dow ɓuuɓol jaleeɗe ko ɓuri juutde e laamlaamuuji ina ummoo ina njippoo, ina nodda jamma e ñalawma tawi noppi ina njuuti, comci ina njuuti. Yeeso ina woodi laana mahaaɗo e dow leydi njoorndi e ndiyam ɗam nanndaani e laana ndiwoowa ka yiytaa ko adii. Mbele aɗa waawi faamde muñal gonngal caggal ndee maraton noddaango?
clues: Mi noddii leñol am jamma e ñalawma, e nder sirlu e peeñɗi, yoo ndewo Alla gooto.
Yimɓe am ɗon ƴakka ko'e maɓɓe nder noppi, ɗon ƴakka limce ngam ɓe ɗon ƴakka am.
Mi heddii e leñol am duuɓi teemedde jeenay e capanɗe joyi miɗo nodda ɓe e ardaade.
Mi mahii feggere les gite Alla e wahyu mum tawi leñol am ina ƴattoo kam e dow leydi yoorndi.
Mi yamiraama yo mi nawtu e nder laana ndiwoowa kala sifaa e gooŋɗinɓe nde yamiroore ndee ari, lowre ndee ɓuuɓtii.
Miɗo ndaara ɓuuɓol ina ummoo no kooseeje nii nde ilam ɗam ɓuuɓnata saliiɓe, Alla hisni wonɓe e laana kaa.
